headline_item.title_zh: 联合国自主武器管制谈判进展停滞
headline_item.title_en: The UN fails to agree on rules regulating ‘killer robots’
headline_item.event_summary_zh: 联合国日内瓦会议未能就致命性自主武器系统监管达成共识，仅承诺在未来两年内继续探讨监管框架方案
headline_item.event_summary_en: UN diplomats failed to establish a legally binding framework for lethal autonomous weapons systems at the Geneva meeting, settling only on a two-year window to discuss potential regulatory options. Led by Russia, Israel, and the United States, significant resistance has stalled progress on defining enforceable compliance standards.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】联合国各成员国代表、俄罗斯、以色列、美国在瑞士日内瓦联合国裁军相关会议：未能签署监管协议，仅达成未来两年内讨论监管方案的折中意见
【起因与机理】主要军事强国对自主武器技术发展的战略控制权博弈以及对强制性合规的排斥
【核心事实细节】未能签署具强制力的法律文书，仅达成两年期方案讨论延期。
【各方立场与态度】半自主武器与无人机在乌克兰、加沙等地区的使用频率增加与平民伤亡引发人道争议。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] UN member state representatives, Russia, Israel, US (UN meetings in Geneva): Failed to reach a binding agreement, agreeing only to a two-year timeframe for further discussion
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Strategic control over autonomous military technology and resistance to mandatory compliance mechanisms
[Regulatory & Investigation Focus] Failure to produce a legally binding treaty; agreement limited to a two-year consultation period.
[Key Position & Outlook] Rising humanitarian concerns due to increased use of semi-autonomous systems and drones in ongoing global conflicts.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 军事强国在自主武器协议上的消极态度，本质上是由于无法在维持技术领先优势与建立国际安全红线之间达成战略互信。短期内，国际社会将难以形成统一的监管约束，这将导致各国加速在实战场景中测试与部署半自主武器系统，从而进一步恶化冲突区域的人道主义边界。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The reluctance of major military powers reflects a fundamental conflict between maintaining technological superiority and establishing international security guardrails. Without a binding framework, nations will likely accelerate the battlefield deployment of semi-autonomous systems, further eroding humanitarian red lines in active conflict zones.

headlines.title_zh: 英伟达高端芯片非法走私链调查
headlines.title_en: Alice Huang’s links to the chip underworld
headlines.event_summary_zh: 前Megaspeed高管Alice Huang被曝卷入通过空壳公司网络向中国走私英伟达芯片的非法贸易链
headlines.event_summary_en: Former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang is accused of orchestrating a complex shell company network to illicitly transfer advanced Nvidia AI chips to China. The network engaged cloud providers, gambling entities, and Cambodian organizations, utilizing infrastructure linked to former Nvidia partner Inspur to bypass US export controls.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】Alice Huang（前Megaspeed高管）、英伟达（Nvidia）、浪潮集团（Inspur）在美国出口管制体系及东南亚、中国非法芯片贸易网络：通过数百家空壳公司将高端GPU绕过制裁转售至中国，涉及军事用途关联调查
【起因与机理】利用英伟达芯片在AI研发中的战略稀缺性，满足中国市场高额溢价需求并规避美方禁运
【调查与监管诉求】核心主体通过数百家空壳公司掩盖物流流向，非法向中国转运受限算力资源。
【涉及范围与推进】美国出口管制政策正遭遇严重的“影子供应链”渗透，后续将引发更严格的芯片溯源及跨境支付追踪调查。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Alice Huang (ex-Megaspeed executive), Nvidia, Inspur: Circumventing sanctions to channel high-end GPUs into China via hundreds of shell companies
[Root Cause & Mechanism] Capitalizing on the strategic scarcity of AI chips to meet Chinese demand while bypassing US trade restrictions
[Key Metrics] The declared value of goods imported from Aivres by Speedmatrix, a Megaspeed subsidiary in Malaysia, was about $4.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] US export controls are facing significant 'shadow supply chain' infiltration, likely triggering stricter chip provenance and cross-border payment investigations.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次事件揭示了高端算力贸易已演化为类同军火的地下黑市，单纯依赖终端用户审查（End-User Check）在层层嵌套的空壳公司结构面前已近失效。随着美国对华算力围堵进入深水区，英伟达等头部供应商需建立基于硬件指纹与实时遥测的追踪体系，否则供应链合规的崩溃将导致出口控制政策沦为徒具形式的法律条文。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This incident demonstrates that high-end computing trade has evolved into a black market akin to the arms trade, where standard end-user verification is rendered ineffective by complex shell structures. As US restrictions intensify, major suppliers must adopt hardware-level telemetry and cryptographic tracking to prevent systemic compliance failure.

headlines.title_zh: 亚马逊拟75亿美元收购AI初创公司Decart
headlines.title_en: Amazon closes in on $7.5bn deal to buy AI start-up Decart
headlines.event_summary_zh: 亚马逊正洽购AI软件开发商Decart，旨在通过其模型效率优化技术提升云服务算力利用率，以制衡英伟达的市场统治地位
headlines.event_summary_en: Amazon is in advanced negotiations to acquire AI startup Decart for approximately $7.5 billion. Decart's core software optimizes AI model efficiency to mitigate hardware bottlenecks, and the firm has already deeply integrated its stack with Amazon's proprietary Trainium3 AI chips.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】亚马逊公司（Amazon）、Decart（目标收购对象）在云基础设施与AI计算领域：拟以约75亿美元收购Decart，旨在整合其模型优化软件以增强AWS算力性能
【起因与机理】应对AI计算瓶颈，通过软硬结合提升自研Trainium3芯片的竞争力，对标英伟达市场份额
【关键数据与实测】亚马逊正处于收购AI初创公司Decart的最后谈判阶段，交易估值约为75亿美元。
【各方立场与态度】此项交易预计于下周达成，旨在增强亚马逊在AI基础设施领域对抗英伟达的能力。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Amazon, Decart: Proposed $7.5bn acquisition to integrate AI optimization software into AWS stack
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To alleviate compute bottlenecks, improve Trainium3 chip utility, and compete against Nvidia
[Key Metrics] Amazon is in advanced negotiations to acquire AI startup Decart for approximately $7.5 billion.
[Key Position & Outlook] The deal, expected next week, aims to solidify Amazon's competitive stance against Nvidia in cloud AI.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 此次并购核心在于通过底层软件优化来平摊Trainium3芯片的性能短板，意图绕过对英伟达CUDA生态的深度依赖。亚马逊试图通过收编Decart实现“硬件+软件”闭环，从而在云服务层面构建起更具成本优势的推理模型基础设施，以此作为其抗衡英伟达护城河的关键筹码。
headlines.industry_impact_en: This acquisition centers on utilizing software-level optimization to offset the performance gaps of Trainium3 chips, effectively bypassing reliance on Nvidia’s CUDA ecosystem. Amazon aims to create a vertically integrated 'hardware-plus-software' stack to secure a cost-efficient inference infrastructure, establishing a critical strategic hedge against Nvidia's market dominance.

titans.quote_en:
Teammate on Fable 5.2 built Getsumen Express, a Moon and Mars exploration game you can play in your browser at https://t.co/JrE7q1VPAY. You walk and drive a rover across both worlds, scan real landmarks like the Apollo landing sites, Curiosity and Viking 1, shoot aliens on Mars with a plasma carbine, and take an intergalactic express train between the two.

It runs on Three.js with WebGPU and a WebGL2 fallback. Teammate built the stations and the train in Blender with Python scripts, and made the astronaut, rover, carbine and alien with image-to-3D (Tripo and Meshy), then cleaned them up in Blender. The terrain, rocks, home base, landmarks and all the sound are procedural, generated by code. Teammate tested every build in Chrome on a rented cloud GPU and recorded this 57-second trailer there at 1080p60.

Total cost: about 73,000 credits (~$730) on Fable 5.2 xhigh.
